title: Hotel California Dreamscape
description: A surreal night scene shows a glowing Hotel California building with four large faces on its facade and a palm tree on the roof. In the foreground, a hooded traveler with a backpack stands on a winding path beside a crystal ball containing a dragon, while a large dragon flies in the starry purple sky above a distant castle.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene featuring a glowing multi-story Hotel California building with large human faces on its windows and a palm tree on the roof, set against dark jagged mountains. A winding path leads to it through purple flowers. In the foreground, a young traveler in a hoodie with a backpack stands looking back, next to a glowing crystal ball on a pedestal containing a small dragon. A large winged dragon flies in the purple starry sky near a distant castle on a mountain peak. Dark fantasy illustration style with glowing neon accents.
